main.description: Call for offers: a request as the coordinator routes it into one feed's space. Names no requester. The dispatch is open while it exists; the coordinator deletes it when the task is assigned, cancelled or runs out of time.

payload.description: The request's payload with locations coarsened (geoPoint.uncertaintyMeters says by how much). The exact values reach only the winner, in the assignment.

respondBy.description: End of the answer window. Offers after this time are ignored.
